results.title: Laos, Thailand Set USD 12 Billion Trade Target for 2027
results.content: Laos and Thailand have set a goal of increasing bilateral trade to USD 12 billion by the end of 2027, while expanding cooperation on transport, energy and border security. results.title: Lao Singer Thinla Finishes Fifth at Inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia
results.content: On 14 November, Lao singer Thinla finished fifth at the first Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, Thailand, with her entry “Bae.” Thinla, whose full name is Thinlamphone Mahavong, was among the contest’s memorable performers.
